clue.text: Game, in a way

definitions.meaning: an old lawn game in which a ball was driven through an iron hoop with a mallet
a famous street in London's St James's district, home to gentlemen's clubs

explanation.surface: Someone is playing a game somewhere along a route.
explanation.definitionFit: The croquet-like pastime gave its name to the London street laid out where it was once played, so one spelling covers sport and road.

clue.text: Soft dressing with hard base

parts.note: p is piano, the musical direction for soft
lint is a fabric used as a wound dressing
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A soft bandage is applied to a firm foundation.
explanation.definitionFit: A square slab under a column or statue is its foundation block.

clue.text: One involved in contract. Fete this for FT

annotationWithheld.why: One involved in contract. Fete this for FT (6): LESS must replace F and T in FETE, but no clue word gives LESS ('this' cannot), so the clue looks misprinted and no source was found
annotationWithheld.clue: One involved in contract. Fete this for FT

clue.text: Ill-tempered doctor showed advance

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, an army doctor
prices that rose showed an advance

explanation.surface: A grumpy physician made progress.
explanation.definitionFit: Sullen and gloomy is the sense of the adjective, a sulky bad mood.

clue.text: One possesses the equipment to be included in the scientific class

definitions.text: One possesses the equipment to be included in the scientific class

parts.words: One possesses the equipment to be included in the scientific class
parts.note: a worker who handles the apparatus in a science department, counted among its support staff

explanation.surface: Owning the right kit earns someone a place among scientists.
explanation.definitionFit: A support worker who maintains apparatus and runs experiments in a research facility.

clue.text: Spike the mischievous one's drink

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous little sprite or a cheeky child
ale is a type of beer, a common drink

explanation.surface: Someone tampers with a prankster's drink by spiking it.
explanation.definitionFit: To spike something is to pierce it on a sharp point, the verb's literal sense.

clue.text: Castle? Short time at north entrance

parts.note: mo is short for moment, a short time
a mouth is an entrance, as of a cave

explanation.surface: Briefly, at a castle's northern gate, someone waits.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a definition by example: the Welsh town has a Norman fortress.
explanation.definitionFit: A Welsh border town famed for its Norman fortress, birthplace of Henry V, so the name stands for that stronghold.

clue.text: Work lathe with voluntary action, being strong and vigorous

indicators.note: work as a verb means knead or shape, so the letters of lathe are reshaped

parts.note: a tic is a twitch, an involuntary action; the clue prints voluntary

explanation.surface: A machinist works a lathe with a twitch, though fit and robust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Work' rearranges LATHE to ATHLE; the printed 'voluntary' should read 'involuntary', as a tic is an involuntary twitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Muscular and sporty in build, fit and energetic like a sportsman.

clue.text: Listener gets hot in row, being less refined

parts.note: an ear is the organ that listens

indicators.note: in puts the letter for hot inside the word for row

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: An eavesdropper gets heated in an argument, showing coarse manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Cruder, more down-to-earth and coarse, the comparative of a word for bawdy.

clue.text: Write name on bone since unsure about it

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters sit around the piece of bone
being unsure suggests the letters of since are not settled and can be rearranged

parts.note: a rib is a bone of the chest

explanation.surface: Someone writes a name on a bone, hesitant about doing so.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unsure' makes INSCE from the letters of 'since', and 'about' puts that round the bone; 'it' just refers back to the bone and gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing one's name on a book or gift is the classic dedication, the sense of engraving words on something.

clue.text: Source of confidence round ranch possibly

indicators.note: possibly says the letters of the round letter and ranch may be arranged another way

parts.note: a round shape is a ring, the letter O

explanation.surface: A rancher's reassurance comes from going round the ranch, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' shuffles O (round) with RANCH to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Figuratively, a person or thing one relies on for stability is called the mainstay or rock that holds one steady.

clue.text: Employer backs about one in attempt to produce society funds

indicators.note: in places the assembled middle part inside the word for attempt

parts.note: a try is an attempt

indicators.note: about means the turned-round employer goes around the letter for one
backs signals that the employer word is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: a user is one who employs something
one can be the article a

explanation.surface: An employer reverses course over one effort to raise money for a society.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backs' turns the employer word round to RESU; 'about' sets it round the one to make REASU, which goes 'in' the attempt word straight after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A society's money is held in its coffers, the fund managed by its treasurer.

clue.text: Hebrew patriarch's old riding coat

definitions.meaning: the son of Jacob sold into Egypt, a figure of Genesis
an eighteenth-century long cloak worn by women on horseback

explanation.surface: A biblical forefather's antique equestrian garment is described.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical son of Jacob famed for his coat of many colours shares his name with a dated term for a buttoned riding greatcoat.

clue.text: See 4
Aware of the way of modern life and 1 across?

definitions.text: Aware of the way of modern life
definitions.meaning: shrewd and savvy about urban living
the London road named in 1 across is a thoroughfare, so it is road-like in manner

explanation.surface: Someone savvy about modern living is compared with a London street.
explanation.definitionFit: Savvy in city ways is the everyday sense, and read as a road-like manner it describes a London thoroughfare.

clue.text: Look after Den — or maybe Bill assigned to me?

indicators.note: after places the word for look at the end
maybe suggests the letters of Den and or could be arranged otherwise

parts.note: see means look

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to look after Den, or perhaps a bill is passed to the speaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Look after' reads like one phrase, but it splits: 'maybe' turns 'Den or' into ENDOR, and 'after' sets the look word behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: The person to whom a cheque or bill of exchange is signed over by the holder is its new payee.

clue.text: Ruler not prepared for the line apparently

definitions.text: Ruler not prepared for the line apparently

parts.words: Ruler not prepared for the line apparently
parts.note: an English king nicknamed the Unready, as if not prepared to take his place in the royal succession

explanation.surface: A ruler seems unready to toe the line.
explanation.definitionFit: The Anglo-Saxon English king known by the epithet Unready, meaning ill-advised.

clue.text: English seat (pew) reupholstered. It's a bloomer

indicators.note: reupholstering remakes a seat, so these letters are refashioned

explanation.surface: A church seat and pew are re-covered, which is a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reupholstered' rearranges E, SEAT and PEW; 'bloomer' means a blunder on the surface but a flower here.
explanation.definitionFit: A climbing garden plant grown for its fragrant flowers, so it blooms.

clue.text: Exceptionally hot or wet in the city? That's remarkable

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters inside the city abbreviation

parts.note: NY is the abbreviation for New York, the city

indicators.note: exceptionally suggests the letters of hot or wet are put in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Unusual heat or rain in an urban area is worth noting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exceptionally' shuffles HOT OR WET into OTEWORTH, placed 'in' NY.
explanation.definitionFit: Something worth noticing is striking, deserving of comment, the plain synonym.

clue.text: A month always comes up in order

parts.note: Dec is short for December

indicators.note: in a down clue comes up means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, always

explanation.surface: Each month there is always an order coming in.
explanation.definitionFit: An official command issued by authority, an edict.

clue.text: Lyrical old English tenor in the film

indicators.note: in puts the three letters inside the word for film

parts.note: pic is short for picture, a film

explanation.surface: An old English tenor sings lyrically in a movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Expressive in the manner of verse, a lyrical quality.

clue.text: Sort of discrimination conjuring up images

indicators.note: conjuring tricks transform things, so the letters of images are turned into something new

explanation.surface: Prejudice is evoked by summoning up mental pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: Prejudice on grounds of how old a person is, like racism or sexism.

clue.text: The first one in needed to deal with the post

definitions.meaning: in cricket, a batsman who starts the innings

definitions.text: needed to deal with the post
definitions.meaning: a letter knife used to slit envelopes

explanation.surface: Whoever arrives first must handle the morning mail.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket batsman who begins the innings shares the name with the paper knife for slitting envelopes.

clue.text: Kind of glance extended at the party?

indicators.note: at here means the length word is attached at the end of the party word

parts.note: a side is a party or faction in a dispute
long means extended in length

explanation.surface: Someone casts a lingering look across the room at a party.
explanation.definitionFit: An oblique look cast out of the corner of the eye is the classic sideways glance.

clue.text: Phrase needs rewriting being in the Old Testament

indicators.note: rewriting a word means putting its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A phrase from the Old Testament has to be redrafted.
explanation.definitionFit: Isaiah describes six-winged celestial attendants of God, angelic beings named only in that book of the Hebrew scriptures.

clue.text: Well-noted texts

parts.note: texts set to many musical notes: the words of operas

explanation.surface: Documents carefully annotated.
explanation.definitionFit: Opera words are printed booklets whose texts are full of musical notes when sung.

clue.text: For cause to be esteemed, finish with the organ

parts.note: an end is a finish
the ear is the organ of hearing

explanation.surface: To win respect, someone concludes with a performance on the church organ.
explanation.definitionFit: To make someone loved or well regarded is the transitive sense of winning affection.

clue.text: How to get in touch using no time? About right

indicators.note: using signals that the letters of no time are put to work in a fresh order

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A quick way of contacting someone that takes no time is roughly correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'using' rearranges NO TIME with C (About) and R (right).
explanation.definitionFit: An internal two-way speaker system lets people in different rooms talk, a means of communication.
